events.description: The CIA brief reports that terrorist groups are cooperating on a plan to kidnap US diplomats or civilians. The conspirators want to force the release of 'Umar 'Abd al-Rahman and other US-held prisoners, and may instead hijack an aircraft or storm a US Embassy. The groups and the location are excised.

CIA Senior Executive Intelligence Brief reports that terrorist groups are cooperating on a plan to kidnap US diplomats or civilians. The conspirators want to force the release of 'Umar 'Abd al-Rahman and other US-held prisoners. They may also hijack an aircraft or storm a US Embassy.

key_claims: Terrorist groups were reportedly cooperating in May 2001 on a plot to kidnap US diplomats or civilians.
The conspirators sought the release of 'Umar 'Abd al-Rahman, the 'blind sheik', and other US-held prisoners.
The brief says the plotters may instead hijack an aircraft or storm a US Embassy.
